title: Abelian original-stalk exchange on total strict-local projective lines
statement: Let S,T,X′ be schemes, with g:T→S, f′:X′→T and g′:X′→P¹_S forming a cartesian square with the projective-line projection [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let k,k′ be separably closed fields and Ω algebraically closed, and let σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T, ι:Spec k′→Spec k and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′ satisfy ι≫σ=τ≫g [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], with eA:Spec A≅S_(νισ), eB:Spec B≅T_(ντ), and set jA=eA≫j_(νισ), jB=eB≫j_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Suppose φ:A→B is local, and ρA:Spec k→Spec κA, ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB obey Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ and ρB≫Spec(κφ)=ι≫ρA, where rA,rB are the residue closed-point maps. For any abelian étale sheaf G on P¹_S [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], put G₀=P¹(jA)^*G and h=P¹(Spec φ). For every natural q, set K=G[0], C₁=H^q(g^*Rf_*K), C₂=H^q(Rf′_*g′^*K), where f:P¹_S→S is the projection, and e=H^q(Ex):C₁→C₂ [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. There are additive equivalences a₁:(C₁)_τ≃H^q(P¹_A,G₀) and a₂:(C₂)_τ≃H^q(P¹_B,h^*G₀) with a₂(e_τ(x))=h^*(a₁(x)) for every x [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No module coefficients, torsion assumption, local closed-point higher-direct-image stalk, or closed-fibre cohomology appears in this conclusion.

proof.text: Use ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map to form the two projective-line pullback squares over the source strict localization and the local homomorphism φ. The projective-line projection is qcqs by properness.

Apply exists_addEquiv_strictHenselization_abelian_stalkExchange to these two squares and the canonical strict-local presentations. Obtain c₁,c₂ identifying the original stalks with the two local closed-point stalks and the equation c₂ Ex = Ex_local c₁.

Apply exists_addEquiv_strictLocal_abelian_total_exchange to the local projective-line square and G₀, obtaining b₁,b₂ and b₂ Ex_local = cohomologyMap b₁. Compose c₁ with b₁ and c₂ with b₂. For x rewrite by the localization equation and apply the strict-local equation to c₁ x. This is precisely the complete existing proof in the adopted module; no closed-fibre or torsion comparison enters.

theorem Etale.projectiveLine_abelian_originalStalk_totalExchange
    {S T X' : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S} {f' : X' ⟶ T} {g' : X' ⟶ ProjectiveLine S}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) g)
    {k k' Ω : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ τ))
    (φ : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hφ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫
        strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) =
      eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ τ) ≫ g)
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ τ) = τ)
    (hρ : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)) = ι ≫ ρA)
    (G : Sheaf (ProjectiveLine S).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    let G₀ := (ProjectiveSpace.map _
      (eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ)))^*[
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}].obj G
    let g₀ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
    let K := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G
    let C₁ := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj
      ((R+((ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
        D+((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)
    let C₂ := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj
      ((D+((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
        R+((f')_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K)
    let e := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      ((Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq.toCommSq).app K)
    ∃ (a₁ : ((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj C₁ ≃+ Sheaf.H G₀ q)
      (a₂ : ((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj C₂ ≃+
        Sheaf.H ((ProjectiveSpace.map _ g₀)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}].obj G₀) q),
      ∀ x, a₂ ((((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map e).hom x) =
        Etale.cohomologyMap (ProjectiveSpace.map _ g₀) G₀ q (a₁ x)
